reviews.text:
The Dog Resort was simply fundamental in transforming our French Bulldog, Noah, after adoption. He was quite reactive, and we had many doubts about how to help him feel safe and confident.

From the first contact, we were welcomed with great affection by Feitosa, Camila, and the team, who demonstrated knowledge, sensitivity, and immense respect for his time and needs. At no point did they try to "force" changes; everything was conducted with patience, love, and techniques that truly respect the well-being of the animals.

Today we see an evolution in his socialization and behavior, and we know that this was only possible thanks to the serious work, the welcoming atmosphere, and the love that the entire The Dog Resort team dedicates to each dog.

Our gratitude is immense. I wholeheartedly recommend them to any pet owner who wants a place where animals are treated with respect, empathy, and lots of affection.

We've been clients for over 10 years. The confidence we have in leaving our dogs with Feitosa and his team is unmatched anywhere else. Their knowledge of animals, especially Bulldogs, is second to none. Excellent facilities, location, and most importantly, love in everything they do. I highly recommend them!
Excellent service. Very healthy and safe environment for small, medium, and large dogs. Easy access and secure entrance.

My dog ​​has been going to this daycare once a week for two years. She loves being there. The staff are very attentive to the dogs and even train them to get along with other dogs. The place is a large house with a huge yard, a place for the dogs to play and run. They separate small and medium-sized dogs from large dogs. They also operate as a hotel. I've left my dog ​​there several times for several days and she has always been very well treated. I recommend this place.

Feitosa and his team are amazing. We have two bulldogs who have gone through several types of training that never resolved their aggression and anxiety, and The Dog Resort welcomed them both with great affection and care. They are professionals who understand dogs and canine behavior and respect the nature of puppies.
The place is super safe and my dogs have never been so happy.
I recommend it without hesitation!
Where my friend feels very happy and fulfilled. He, Samuka, loves the whole The Dog team. Thank you guys.
Excellent daycare and school for dogs! Organized facilities, clean and safe environment, qualified and extremely dedicated professionals. I recommend it without a doubt!

We had an excellent experience with Johnny's start at The Dog Resort. The environment is spacious, very clean and organized — very pleasant.
The school staff was very welcoming, the introduction technique with the new friends was very tactful and careful, leaving Johnny calm and happy. Johnny — my rescued dog from the woods who has already given so much trouble with some socializations — was comfortable and playful.
The tranquility of the pack impressed me. I've been to some places where the level of anxiety seems to spread uncontrollably. And in this school, the work that has been done collectively is clear. And this mental health is undoubtedly the basis for a healthy and happy dog! It brought me great relief and hope that I have finally found the right place. Johnny starts school on Tuesday and we are super excited!!

Regarding the location itself, I didn't have my system register it because I was cycling around the area. My system's programming ended up capturing the location. However, I don't have any experience to share with you about it.

My dog ​​attends daycare 3 times a week.

He has chronic health problems, and for this reason, we had a lot of difficulty finding a suitable daycare for him. Luckily, The Dog Resort welcomed us, listened to all our concerns and restrictions so that he could attend daycare and socialize.

We don't have a single complaint! I know he's in great hands while we work, and after 4 months of daycare, he remains healthy, without relapses of his chronic illness, and we as his owners couldn't be happier.

We wanted a daycare to be an extension of our dog's home, and we found that at The Dog Resort.

As a veterinarian and owner, I recommend them 100%! They know how to handle dogs of all sizes.

I scheduled a visit for today, Saturday, with my dog, by phone, to see the place after contacting the company via WhatsApp.

However, upon arriving at the location today (scheduled 2 weeks in advance), I was not attended to, as no one on the team at the time was aware of my visit (again, scheduled 2 weeks in advance).

In short, we left without visiting the place and without any further explanation for the inconvenience.

This was my terrible experience with Dog Resort.

The best hotel and daycare for our best friends! My dog ​​has been going there since he was a puppy, and without a doubt, they have contributed a lot to his training and maintaining his health! He goes once a week to burn off energy and has stayed for longer periods when I travel. Highly recommended!
An amazing place! And the team that takes such good care of our furry children is simply wonderful. There's nothing like it!
